UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Publicly scoped account metadata for an authenticated April AI user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown inside the user's own workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest account activity.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record containing the authenticated user's email.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the Google account.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A persistent conversation belonging strictly to one authenticated Google account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

name.description: Conversation title derived from the first user message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation last received a message.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message stored in the conversation's messages subcollection.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

attachmentNames.description: Optional bounded list of attached file names.

actions.description: Optional bounded list of structured April IA proposed actions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-account root document verifying account existence for subcollections.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only private profile document storing isolated PII (email).

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Messages belonging to a specific user's chat session.
